tokenspeed.runtime.execution.distributed.why: Only the call with cpu_group= is gated: DistributedInitializer.initialize's cross-rank minimum, which init_distributed returns as the device memory gpu_memory the KV profile takes its utilization headroom from (KV = free - post_profile - gpu_memory x (1 - --gpu-memory-utilization)). Read under the busy cap it is the cap, the headroom shrinks and the KV pool takes the activations' memory; gated, every rank reads the device's free memory. Its other calls there (log lines, the per-rank balance check) pass straight through. The result goes to stderr, the value the server sized with.

tokenspeed.runtime.model_loader.loader.why: The model's construction, run under the target device inside startup phase weights.allocate, which allocates the weights at once.

tokenspeed.runtime.execution.model_runne.why: Allocates the model's communication buffers before cache planning (startup phase communication.prepare), for the target and the draft model.

tokenspeed.runtime.layers.attention.regi.why: The free-memory profile that sizes the KV cache. registry.py imports the function by name, so the registry's binding is wrapped.
